list: The official 55 PS5 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (reported 18 November 2026). 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned; all single-player, no online trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the list below and it follows on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end. It is the first story trophy and unlocks as the story starts; story trophies pop as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it does not fire immediately. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it is the one thing in the chapter that can be missed (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens up during this chapter, and once both are playable most of the list opens up with them, including every trophy that needs your partner beside you.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Robbery tools arrive through optional and story missions in the middle of the game, so by this chapter jewelry store robberies and the racing strands are opening up.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The big bank vault jobs unlock through an optional mission near the end of this chapter, so the robbery trophies start here rather than earlier.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep a manual save from just before the final mission — the game has 15 manual save slots, and a save at the start of each chapter is the safety net the guides recommend.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Like every mission trophy it pops when the mission ends, so just play the story through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy: it unlocks when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A story trophy: it unlocks when the mission is done.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A story trophy: it unlocks when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy: it unlocks when the mission is done. The airport in its name is the same VCIA where the free-roam plane trophy is earned, but the two are separate unlocks.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy: it unlocks when the mission is done.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is over — work done earlier still counts. You do not need every collectible or activity in the game: the checklist asks for set portions, for example 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 70 of 80 Challenges and 300 of 397 stunts, but all 42 Shooting Range gold medals and all 8 bank vaults. Do it after the story, checking the list as you go, and skip anything once its number is met.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping at the pop.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. Dip into every activity as it unlocks — races, fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, pool, mini golf, basketball and the rest — rather than leaving them all for cleanup.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — two ranges with 42 gold medals between them. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so this is one of the long grinds: practice a range until its gold time or score is comfortable, then move to the next.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Winning at least one race per location is the requirement, and the 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials completed, so fly the trials at each location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20 — the extra wins count toward both.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The description names the whole task: find Cal's fishing challenge once fishing is open to you and out-fish him. It is an activity trophy, not a story one, so it stays available in free roam.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. The 100% checklist asks you to play all four video games, so finishing one here also starts that count — play the rest while you are at the arcade.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the story ends, so finishing the story cannot lock this out — follow Andy's strand whenever it appears and see it through to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the story ends, so follow Kenton's strand when it appears and finish its last mission at your own pace.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the story ends, so follow Billy's strand when it appears and finish its last mission at your own pace.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count, so watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One step is time-sensitive — the Chapter 3 race against Yago in his street racing strand carries an hourglass icon — so save first, then race it the moment it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the story ends, so follow Randy's strand when it appears and finish its last mission at your own pace.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the story ends, so follow Tyrone's strand when it appears and finish its last mission at your own pace.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy every guide flags as potentially missable: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, when she mentions meditating in the morning at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept — disappears once Chapter 1 ends, so do it before leaving the chapter and keep a Chapter 1 save. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating with your partner counts the spot for both characters, so bring them along. For 100% completion only 15 of the 18 are needed, but this trophy wants all 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only and runs through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. The 100% checklist needs all 15 of Bret's target decks, so the hunting strand is worth finishing in full.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so three sets is the early milestone on the way — keep collecting cards as you find them and the bigger number follows.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan unfamiliar vehicles and landmarks as you meet them from the start of the game — scanning a vehicle also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so one habit feeds two trophies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, and many complete on their own while you play, so check the list after the story and chase the ones closest to done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Partner play opens in Chapter 2, once you can switch characters and call the other one in. A bank vault job gives you 4 stars straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time as Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner first, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you; if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; adrenaline extends Focus, giving you time for all five.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy is delayed, so keep flying until it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a reported good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner — and the 4-star wanted level a vault job brings earns Hot Together on the escape. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Like the other robbery trophies it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area — keep driving until the wanted level is fully gone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the map uncovers as you travel it. Push into unvisited regions between missions rather than leaving the whole map for cleanup; flying, boating and driving through new areas all fill it in.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way — just make sure the operations you rob cover all nine gangs rather than the same few.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No unlock method is confirmed at launch — this is one of five hidden trophies whose trigger no guide has confirmed yet — so the description itself is the only solid lead: find a spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail, and see. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing a location.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No unlock method is confirmed at launch — this is one of five hidden trophies whose trigger no guide has confirmed yet — so the description is the lead: a showroom smash-out, in the style of the series' classic opening. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing a showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2: bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. Leaving something behind is not missable: the operation comes back later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Reported, not yet fully confirmed: it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength — buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Reported: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, a count PlayStation tracks. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game and check the counter.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No unlock method is confirmed at launch — this is one of five hidden trophies whose trigger no guide has confirmed yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something; this guide marks it unconfirmed rather than inventing a method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No unlock method is confirmed at launch — this is one of five hidden trophies whose trigger no guide has confirmed yet. The description hints at witnessing something strange out in Leonida; this guide marks it unconfirmed rather than inventing a location.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Reported as a melee drive-by elimination, but the precise method is still being confirmed by the guides — treat the drive-by reading as reported, not settled, and try it from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts; the $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole game. The 100% checklist also needs $250,000 of marked bills fenced.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so ordinary spending on weapons, clothes, food and vehicles all counts — buy the gear and garages the other trophies need and this fills up on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight garages, bought in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count. Buy them early: each one also gives you space to register cars for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
